Island_169.terrain_character: A dark frontier of broken woods, misty hollows, boggy lowlands, old roads, ruins, and isolated uplands. Wet Blackfen-style terrain can exist within the region without expanding into the neighboring southern island group.
Island_169.settlement_role: Sparse frontier villages, ruined crossings, isolated hamlets, old forts, graveyards, and abandoned estates separated by difficult terrain.
Island_169.primary_function: Old frontier and haunted woodland-wetland region
Island_169.secondary_feature: Dark forests, peat bogs, blackwater channels, flooded ruins, battlefields, graveyards, abandoned roads
Island_169.travel_role: A compact western frontier region reached by a few old roads and crossings; travel should feel uncertain and increasingly isolated within the group.
Island_169.lore_notes: The Haunted Marches occupies the compact western island group marked in pink. The adjacent lower western group is intentionally left separate for another major region.
